alex_m: Anyone else seeing outbound requests from nodepool-a failing? App pods show ready but external calls either hang or return 502s. Started right after the egress policy rollout ~10:20.
lee_infra: Seeing the same from our metrics. Envoy upstream errors spiking, lots of connection resets. No obvious pod restarts.
sam_ops: My hunch is SNAT port exhaustion on those nodes — high ephemeral port churn after the policy tightened. Can someone dump conntrack counts?
jenna_sre: Confirmed high conntrack usage on nodepool-a nodes, some nodes at 95% of nf_conntrack max. Also seeing DNS UDP failures intermittently which would explain hanging calls.
maria: Envoy stderr tail: ```[2026-03-15T10:22:41Z] envoy upstream reset: connection reset by peer
[2026-03-15T10:22:41Z] upstream request timeout 2s
[2026-03-15T10:22:42Z] handshake failed: no available upstreams```
oncall-bot: Incident created INC-2026-348 and oncall paged.
alex_m: I'm going to roll back the egress-profile that tightened sidecar outbound rules (egress-profile-2026-03) to see if that clears it.
lee_infra: After rollback we see an immediate drop in connection resets on a couple nodes, but ~20% of pods still have stuck outbound sockets — likely sockets in TIME_WAIT / port reuse issues.
sam_ops: We also have a known kernel conntrack/udp churn issue on the node image (linux-5.4-custom) where ephemeral ports get exhausted faster. Suggest rolling nodes to linux-5.15 or applying conntrack tuning as short-term.
maria: Can we route nodepool-a egress through the egress-gateway and give it a larger SNAT pool as a mitigation? That should reduce per-node port pressure.
jenna_sre: Deployed a canary egress-gateway for 2 nodes and added ip-masq rules to preserve source ports. Early telemetry looks good: DNS failures dropped and outbound success rate normalized on the canary. :thumbsup:
alex_m: Nice. I'll coordinate a rolling restart of affected deployments and schedule a node image roll for nodepool-a. Please add the kernel note to the postmortem.
oncall-bot: INC-2026-348 status: monitoring (will auto-close when no errors for 30m).
